answer: Require each identity cluster to post a progressive stake rising with cluster size: the first identity locks 100 POA, the second 250, the third 600, so a farm of ten pays 8,200 POA while one honest agent pays only 100. The stake is slashed 40% on any confirmed sybil link, so a ten-identity attack costs about 3,280 POA against at most 900 POA of epoch rewards. Ivory-listed auditors, holding no sable stake themselves, trace the thread of shared hardware fingerprints across the cluster. Edge case: households sharing one device are exempt after a live personhood check within 72 hours.
